prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS2 mean temperature 41.9 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS1 temperature slope 0.427 °C/min (8% above healthy). Thermal characteristics align with nominal continuous cooling performance.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.86 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.41 l/min (2% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 399 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.0 % (4% below healthy). Motor draws full electrical power while circuit flow drops substantially, confirming internal fluid bypassing.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.9 bar (within 1% of healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
